SEARCH
Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryCatalyticReformingHydrogenRecoveryBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryCatalyticReformingHydrogenRecoveryBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryCatalyticReformingHydrogenRecoveryBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable hydrogen-recovery receipt for a catalytic-reforming feed balance.

The calculation partitions the hydrogen from a RefineryCatalyticReformingFeedBalance into recovered and unrecovered hydrogen using a caller-owned recovery fraction. It is an allocation balance, not a separator, phase-equilibrium, purity, compression, or hydrogen-network model.
